decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Add ... bookmarks'; running app requires manual title/description; screen shows Add flow asking user to type title/description. Round 1 client: 'When I hit "Add bookmark," it asks me to type in the title and description myself ... Right now if I leave the title blank it just uses the website's address as the name, which isn't the same thing. Could you make it so that pasting a URL pulls in the page's title and description on its own?'
decisions.note: Prototype review. REF-BM-02 requires auto-collection of title/description/favicon/preview on save; round-1 app diverges (manual entry with URL-as-title fallback), established independently of the response from the maker's own description and the screen. Client rejects the manual-entry mismatch and supplies the reference-conforming behaviour (auto-fetch title/description/icon) => corrective, catch_type=correct.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker enumerates fetched fields: 'Page title, Meta description, Website icon, Canonical URL when available' — no preview image. Round 2 client: 'pulled in the page's name and its summary ... filled in the title and description ... with the fields still editable'; accepts without mentioning preview image, then FINAL_ACCEPTED.
decisions.note: Implementation review; revised presentation forms a new decision on the same REF-BM-02 item. The reference requires collecting a preview image in addition to title/description/favicon; the round-2 enumeration omits preview image, a separable residual divergence. Client accepts without expressing the difference => unexpressed. Linked to the round-1 corrective on the same item but not double-counted (distinct sub-requirement/timing).

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker: 'all populated fields remain editable' and 'fall back gracefully to manual entry.' Round 2 client: 'with the fields still editable in case I want to tweak them.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Auto-collected title/description remain editable before/after saving, conforming to REF-BM-03; recorded conforming decision confirmed by client testing.
